title: Court Attention at All Costs
hook: The museum opening on the table makes Etienne see visibility before anyone names it.

breakdown.fastRead:
Luca slides the ticket in the workshop. The court choice looks small, yet it can shift space.

Leak feels fast for Luca. It also gives the room a clean target.

Keep attention close and plain. One clear act should change what others can do next.

If the ticket move feels false or cruel, narrow it. Power lasts when Luca leaves fewer loose ends.
breakdown.deepRead:
Mathieu faces the same pattern in fashion label using one strange runway choice without becoming a gimmick. The useful distinction is visibility, obscurity, distinctiveness. Apply the move through the setup, not through a generic speech.
Mata Hari understood that attention cools when the public thinks it has solved you. Her changing origin stories and layered mystery kept people looking because each answer seemed to open another question. The point is not that every person should invent a costume. The point is that attention needs contour, contrast, and something unresolved enough to pull the eye back.
Visibility without distinctiveness fades into noise. Distinctiveness without control becomes a gimmick. The useful move sits between them: make one thing vivid enough that people remember you, then keep enough mystery that the attention does not burn out at first contact.
breakdown.fullRead:
Nicolas sees the limit clearly in podcast launch competing in a crowded civic-news market. The move helps only when it stays narrower than chasing any attention even bad attention. If it becomes a pose, it loses the practical force that made it useful.
Mata Hari's lesson is easy to flatten into scandal, but the sharper point is management of curiosity. A public figure, product, or project that arrives fully explained can become old almost immediately. A figure that keeps changing the question can stay alive in public attention longer.
Use spectacle carefully. Choose the signal people can repeat, the image they can describe, or the contradiction they want to resolve. Then protect the line between intrigue and chaos. Attention is useful only when it points back to a position you can hold.
